annotation.justification: The clause unambiguously states that recursive resolvers should include the same ECS option in SVCB queries as in A/AAAA queries when the SVCB record contains IP addresses or directs to a subnet‑specific TargetName. No alternative materially different interpretations or missing constraints are evident.
